governing_question: Do analytic TC dilation and arithmetic tau-grid dilation admit a common zeta-intrinsic intertwining law?

analytic_tc_dilation_operator.log_space_action: x = log n |-> T_K(x) = tau^{-K} * x (dilation in log-space)

arithmetic_grid_dilation_operator.dirichlet_action: sum a_n n^{-s} |-> sum a_n (tau^K n)^{-s} = tau^{-K * s} sum a_n n^{-s}
arithmetic_grid_dilation_operator.log_space_action: x = log n |-> S_K(x) = x + K * log(tau) (translation in log-space)

conflation_audit.resolution: Definitively resolved: n^{tau^{-K}} is base-power dilation (log-space scaling); tau^K n is linear grid scaling (log-space translation). They belong to dual geometric categories in the 1D affine group.

non_commutation.A_K_D_J: A_K(D_J[F])(s) = tau^{-J * tau^{-K} * s} * F(tau^{-K} * s)

log_space_commutator.interpretation: Non-commutation of translation and scaling in log-space

mellin_transform_duality.linear_scaling: M o M_{tau^K} = D_K o M (linear scaling x |-> tau^K x maps to arithmetic grid dilation D_K)
mellin_transform_duality.power_scaling: M o P_K = A_K o M (power scaling x |-> x^{tau^K} with Jacobian tau^K maps to analytic dilation A_K)
mellin_transform_duality.intertwining_verdict: Case C: No universal linear intertwiner exists between linear scaling and power scaling on function spaces.

generic_dirichlet_algebra: Semidirect commutation A_K D_J = D_{J * tau^{-K}} A_K
zeta_specific_structures: Euler product: preserved under A_K; broken under D_K
Completed xi reflection: preserved under A_K about Re(s)=tau^K/2; broken under D_K by tau^{K(2s - 1)}
Zero locus: transported by A_K (rho |-> tau^K rho); fixed by D_K (rho |-> rho)

euler_product_result.analytic_tc: Preserved: zeta(tau^{-K} s) = prod_p (1 - (p^{tau^{-K}})^{-s})^{-1} (unique factorization in generalized bases)
euler_product_result.arithmetic_grid: Broken: prod_p (1 - (tau^K p)^{-s})^{-1} = sum tau^{-K Omega(n) s} n^{-s} != tau^{-K s} zeta(s)
euler_product_result.lattice_closure: tau^K m * tau^K n = tau^{2K} m n in L_{2K} != L_K. L_K is an additive lattice, not a multiplicative semigroup.

completed_xi_result.analytic_tc: Preserves reflection symmetry: A_K[xi](tau^K - s) = A_K[xi](s)
completed_xi_result.arithmetic_grid: Breaks reflection symmetry: D_K[xi](1 - s) = tau^{K(2s - 1)} D_K[xi](s)
completed_xi_result.symmetry_breaking_modulus: |tau^{K(2s - 1)}| = tau^{2 * K * delta} (pure phase on critical line; exponential radial deviation off-line)

bilateral_and_spectral_defect_result.commutator_zero_evaluation: Normalized commutator ratio at zero s = tau^K rho has modulus tau^{K_eff * delta} with K_eff = J * (tau^K - 1)
